about: Stages and timing for the findability playbook. scripts/handoff.py reads this file: the stages it tracks, the outcomes each stage can record, and how long to wait between stages. Each key is explained under notes.

stages.name: triage
stages.do: Triage the dead-end searches, add the synonym, data and catalog-gap findings, and agree with the user which to act on.

stages.name: audit
stages.do: Audit the product data behind the dead-end searches: titles and attributes missing the words shoppers use.

skip_when.reason: the triage found no dead-end searches worth acting on.

stages.name: enhance
stages.do: Write reviewed title and attribute suggestions for the audit's top products, as files for the feed team. Nothing changes in Bloomreach.

skip_when.reason: the audit found no products whose data needs work.
the audit stage was skipped, so there are no products to enhance.

stages.name: config
stages.do: Check the attributes shoppers' words live in are searchable, and list the dashboard settings to change.

skip_when.reason: the triage found no dead-end searches worth acting on.

stages.name: synonyms
stages.do: Plan the triage's synonym fixes, preview each, create them switched off and switch each on, every batch after its own yes.

skip_when.reason: the triage found no dead-end searches worth acting on.

stages.name: recheck
stages.do: Triage again over the days since the synonyms went live, and count which of the run's dead-end searches recovered.

skip_when.reason: no synonym went live, so there is nothing to re-check.
the synonyms stage was skipped, so no synonym went live.

notes.recheck_after_days: Days after the synonyms stage finishes (the synonyms were switched on) before the recheck stage is due. discovery-zero-results-triage reads 30 days by default; four whole weeks after the hourly synonym sync gives it a window that starts after the change, with the same weekday mix.
notes.playbooks: Each playbook's title, product and stages in order. A stage names the skill that does it, whether that skill writes, what to do, the outcomes it can record, not_before (wait this rules key's number of days after another stage is done) and skip_when (suggest skipping when another stage had one of these outcomes).
notes.max_chosen: How many findings can be chosen at once. The synonyms stage acts on every synonym fix the user agrees in one plan, up to this many.
